segments.text: Desk takes the last bed, eleven names for ten beds. Eleven names. Say it with me.
I want quiet. My name off.
Door test, name spoken, bag carried, same hands. Without it Elias sleeps wet.
Wet. I want that bed sold.
Outside too. Peter's never stood here.
Want it sold? Peter's cash. Carrying hands hold no money.
These hands weren't at that board.
Board hands. Elias wants it. Money speaks, Peter doesn't.
Tight rope, same hands. Sleep tight.
Held tight. Ten names, ten beds. None mine.
Eleven names, ten beds. Desk tonight.
